title: Store codes and prices
summary: He digresses on store pricing codes.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Politics, race and the state of the country

blocks.x: See, of course, if you get...what you got to do is just like this girl that was here today. I know why she don't want to do it, because she don't know how to put it together. But I don't want anybody to tell me that this isn't important--listen, person goes into a store...they're really messed up, Dan, when it comes down to looking at those prices and things, 'Cause you can't read it, you can't...they have...first of all, the stores they have their own codes. That's number one. They got to get you on that. So now how you going to get beyond that code when you don't know what it is, you don't know the meaning of it.
Sure, I was trying to figure out-- Well, certain things have to be date-stamped; but other things, they have, as you say, their
own code and you can't tell how long a thing's been up there.
They know, they know that any prize thing they get ten days to reduce it. They know that. So the stores need to give the purchasers a better shake.
